title: Outcomes of Anterior Chamber, Sulcus, and Pars Plana Glaucoma Drainage Device Placement in Glaucoma Patients
indication: refractory glaucoma of mixed types (mostly POAG, mixed mechanism and pseudoexfoliation; mostly severe stage) treated with Ahmed or Baerveldt drainage devices
decision: No admissible series: the analysis set is selected by a postoperative outcome. Methods, inclusion criterion 2: 'at least 3 months of follow-up without additional procedures'. Eyes that needed an additional procedure during the first months were excluded from every visit, so all Table 3 means (including day 1 to 3 months) are computed over eyes free of that outcome; protocol inclusion 4 and the brief exclude analysis sets of eyes without reoperation.

groups.description: glaucoma drainage device with the tube in the anterior chamber (Table 3 'AC'); role not assessed because no series is admissible
glaucoma drainage device with the tube in the ciliary sulcus (Table 3 'S'); role not assessed because no series is admissible
glaucoma drainage device with the tube through the pars plana with vitrectomy (Table 3 'PP'); role not assessed because no series is admissible

exclusions.what: Table 3 IOP Mean (SD) rows for AC, S and PP at preoperative, 1 day, 2 weeks, 6 weeks, 3 months, 6 months, 1, 1.5 and 2 years (tab3 C2-C4 of rows 5, 9, 15, 21, 27, 33, 39, 45, 51)
exclusions.reason: analysis set selected by a postoperative outcome (inclusion required at least 3 months of follow-up without additional procedures); protocol inclusion 4
changes from the same outcome-selected analysis set

exclusions.what: Table 3 P value columns and 'P value compared to baseline' rows
Table 6 life table, Figure 2 Kaplan-Meier, Table 7 hazard ratios
exclusions.reason: Kaplan-Meier estimates and model estimates are not admissible

notes: Tonometer: Goldmann applanation; preoperative IOP was the average of the two visits before surgery (Methods).
The first 40 eligible eyes per tube location were drawn by simple random sampling (120 eyes of 120 patients).
